# Munari

> HTML, 3D, and Shaders, Unified. Munari renders retained HTML in Three.js scenes through Chrome's HTML-in-canvas capability, preserving the original DOM and state.

The current public API is documented in the README and published types.
[Decision #43](docs/decisions.md#43) records the retained-HTML API adoption.
Earlier decisions describe historical interfaces and must be read with their
later amendments.

## Start in the version you are using

- [README and package setup](README.md)
- [Munari agent skill](.agents/skills/munari/SKILL.md)

In a checkout, confirm the repository, branch and dirty scope, then choose a
task route below. In an installed package, read its index.d.ts and advanced.d.ts
for exact APIs. The package currently ships the two guides above, not the full
repository docs or registry. Obtain missing guidance from a proven matching
release revision; do not substitute mutable main as version-local truth.

- [Canonical document map and status](docs/README.md)

Superseded proposals and completed implementation plans remain in Git history.
Use the README and exported types for current usage and signatures. Treat a
capability skip as untested behavior.
